description: AIDD hooks: session context, generated-output protection, terminology refresh, and local conversation logs.

hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { root="$PWD"; while [ "$root" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$root/.aidd-role.json" ]; do root="$(dirname "$root")"; done; }; node "$root/.ai/tools/aidd_hook.mjs" session-brief
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if (-not $root) { $dir = Get-Item .; while ($dir -and -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir.FullName '.aidd-role.json'))) { $dir = $dir.Parent }; if ($dir) { $root = $dir.FullName } }; node (Join-Path $root '.ai/tools/aidd_hook.mjs') session-brief"
